title: Native Weil open-closed triangle before taking compact image
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the categories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(-)$ and the actual equivariant derived operations $h^*,Rh_*,Rh_{0!}$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] $k_0$-scheme locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $j:U\to X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion, both over $k_0$, with complementary images. For every $K\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X)$ there is a distinguished triangle $S$ in $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X)$ and isomorphisms
$$S_1\cong Rj_{0!}j^*K,\qquad S_2\cong K,\qquad S_3\cong Ri_*i^*K.$$
Only the existence of these vertex isomorphisms is asserted; no prescribed-arrow or uniqueness assertion is included.

proof.text: Define a and b on the complex C degree by degree by the counit of aj and the unit of ai. The chain-map identities are precisely their naturality equations, in the symmetry required by HomologicalComplex.Hom.comm. The composition vanishes degree by degree by the heart sequence. HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact therefore makes this a short exact sequence of native equivariant complexes.

proof.text: Apply DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES to obtain the ambient distinguished triangle T0. For its first vertex, use the factorization comparisons for j^* and j_!, map the representative isomorphism eC, then apply the private open comparison constructed from native proper/open interchange and the derived identity. This gives e1: T0.obj1 ≅ (Rj_! j^*K).obj. For its third vertex use the factorization comparisons for i^* and i_*, map eC, then the inverse of the existing rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory for the exact closed direct image. This gives e3: T0.obj3 ≅ (Ri_* i^*K).obj. The middle isomorphism is eC. These are isomorphisms inside the native derived category, hence respect Frobenius.

proof.text: Take the vertices of T to be the already defined native Weil complexes A=Rj_!j^*K, K and D=Ri_*i^*K. Transport the first two arrows of T0 by e1,eC,e3. Transport its connecting arrow by e3 inverse and the shifted e1, and then by the inverse shift comparison of the full-subcategory inclusion. Fullness makes these actual arrows of WeilComplex. Their image triangle is isomorphic to T0 by e1 inverse,eC inverse,e3 inverse; cancellation of the isomorphisms and functoriality of shift prove the three squares. The inherited distinguished-triangle definition therefore makes T distinguished. Its vertex witnesses are identity isomorphisms. Since the vertices are the existing values of the restricted functors, their bounded constructibility is already supplied by their definitions; separate cohomology and amplitude estimates are unnecessary here.
